name: Shadowbound
body:
In the twilight realms where darkness whispers secrets and the veil between worlds is thinnest dwell Shadowbounds. These individuals have been forever altered by their communion with shadows, merging with a shadow entity in a moment of desperation, curiosity, or fate. Now existing as beings of and darkness, Shadowbounds navigate the world with a foot in each realm, their very essence a blend of the material and the ethereal.

The origins of Shadowbounds are varied, with each story unique to its bearer. Some sought power and found it in the shadows, others were cursed or blessed by deities of the dark, and a few were simply in the wrong place at the right time, or perhaps the right place at the wrong time.

Regardless of how they came to be, a Shadowbound is marked by its experience, carrying the power of darkness within it like a second soul to be wielded against its foes.

Habitat

Shadowbounds are drawn to places where darkness reigns, finding comfort in the embrace of the night. They thrive in the forgotten corners of the world: ancient ruins swallowed by time, deep caverns untouched by the sun, and bustling cities where shadows gather in narrow alleys and hidden nooks. Here, in these places of darkness and mystery, the Shadowbound find their power at its zenith, and the boundary between the planes grows thin.

Description

To the casual observer, a Shadowbound might appear as any other member of their original race, but a closer look reveals the darkness that clings to them. Their eyes shimmer with a subtle, shadowy light, and their presence seems to dim the illumination around them. Shadows dance at their command, responding to their moods and desires, and they move with a grace that belies their connection to the ethereal.

A Shadowbound wield the power of darkness not as a weapon, but as an extension of their will, manipulating it to hide, to protect, and sometimes to ensnare. They can merge with the shadows, becoming invisible to the unwary eye, or wrap themselves in darkness to ward off attacks. Yet, for all their command over the dark, Shadowbounds are not immune to its whispers, constantly resisting the pull towards oblivion and the loss of self that comes with too deep a dive into the void.

Abilities and Powers

Shadowbounds possess a natural affinity for darkness and shadow, able to see in the blackest nights as if it were day. They can communicate with creatures of the dark, call upon shadows to obscure themselves or allies, and even traverse short distances by stepping through one shadow and emerging from another. Their unique bond with darkness grants them resistance to enchantments and illusions, for what tricks can fool one who walks with shadows? Yet, for all their strengths, Shadowbounds walk a precarious path. Too long in the light weakens them, fading their powers and leaving them vulnerable. They must balance their time between the darkness that strengthens them and the world of light in which they must live, always mindful of the shadow that lurks within, waiting to consume.

Interaction with Other Races

Shadowbounds are often met with suspicion and fear, for darkness is the realm of the unknown, and few trust what they cannot see. Some even seek to bridge the gap between their world and the light, serving as guardians against the threats that lurk in the dark. Others embrace their nature, becoming spies, thieves, or seekers of forbidden knowledge, using their powers to navigate the complexities of society from the safety of the shadows.

Regardless of the path they choose, all Shadowbound are bound by the dark pact that granted them their powers, forever marked by the moment they stepped beyond the realm of light and into the embrace of shadow.

Shadowbound Traits

Shadowbound are enigmatic beings tied to the realm of shadows, possessing unique traits derived from their affinity for darkness and their ethereal nature. This connection imbues them with abilities that allow them to navigate the world in ways others cannot. While playing as a Shadowbound, you gain the following racial traits:

Ability Score Increase. Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1, reflecting the agility and mysterious allure granted by your shadowy bond.
Age. Shadowbounds mature at the same rate as humans but are granted extended longevity by the shadows, living up to 150 years.
Alignment. The nature of Shadowbounds often leads them towards neutrality, with their actions and decisions heavily influenced by their experiences within the shadow realm.
Size. Shadowbounds generally mirror the human form in size, standing anywhere from slightly under to slightly over 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.
Speed. The influence of the shadows on your being grants you a base walking speed of 35 feet, enhancing your movement with the grace of darkness.
Senses. Darkvision. Your deep connection to the shadow realm provides you with superior vision in dark and dim conditions, allowing you to see in dim light within 120 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Languages. You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.
Shadow Affinity. You know the chill touch cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the darkness spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the bestow curse spell with it. Once you cast any of these spells with this trait, you can’t cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
Shadow Step. At 5th level, you gain the ability to navigate the shadows with ease. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.
Shadow Resistance. Your exposure to the shadow realm has fortified you against necrotic damage, granting you resistance to such energies.
Shadowbound Weaknesses. Your close ties to the shadows confer upon you unique strengths, yet they also expose you to distinct frailties and limitations, marking a fine balance between power and vulnerability.
Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Sacred Ground: Your connection to the shadow realm bars you from entering hallowed ground without suffering consequences. While within a similar space, you take 1d10 radiant damage at the start of each of your turns.
Reflection of Duality: In mirrors and reflective surfaces, your reflection occasionally flickers between your current form and a shadowy visage, revealing your dual nature to those who observe closely.
Radiant Vulnerability: Woven from the fabric of shadows, your essence is particularly susceptible to radiant energy. You are vulnerable to radiant damage, reflecting the antithetical nature of light against your shadowy existence.
